title: StockEntry.get_items() takes 1 positional argument but 3 were ERPNext v15.72.3

posts.name: Hardik
posts.cooked:
Hi Team,

After updating to ERPNext v15.64.0 and Frappe v15.72.0, we encountered the following error when trying to create a Stock Entry from a Work Order:

on work order finished time this given me.

TypeError: StockEntry.get_items() takes 1 positional argument but 3 were given

File “apps/erpnext/erpnext/manufacturing/doctype/work_order/work_order.py”, line 1505, in make_stock_entry
stock_entry.get_items(qty, work_order.production_item)
TypeError: StockEntry.get_items() takes 1 positional argument but 3 were given

  • We have not overridden the make_stock_entry method or the StockEntry doctype.
  • This issue seems to stem from a mismatch between the method call and the updated definition of get_items() in the ERPNext core, which now accepts only self.

Could you please confirm if this is a regression or if any additional migration steps are needed to align with the new method signature?

how to solved this.
